notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + in-app guidance). Evaluating Hosted API to prove flow, then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost. Priority: lower per-token cost for high QPS support workload + embeddings for semantic search.

Key asks from product/infra: 
- Latency SLO: 95th pct < 200ms (US), acceptable 250-300ms for EU/APAC via regional routing.
- Throughput: initial 80 reqs/s peak for chat (avg 40ms token gen?), embeddings 300 reqs/min.
- Cost sensitivity: internal target < $0.0008 per embedding unit, and reduce gen token cost by 30% vs hosted trial numbers.
- Model preferences: open-weights preferred (cost), but willing to evaluate Redwood-verified closed models if quality/lower latency warranted.
- Routing: need ability to pin traffic to region and fallback to cheaper smaller-quantized variants during bursts.

POC scope agreed: 
- 2-week Dedicated POC with representative traffic replay (subset of prod).
- One cost optimization workshop (90 min) during week 1 covering: batching policies, prefix/KV caching, quantization profiles and tradeoffs, and unit-economics modelling.
- Deliverables: config repo for batching/caching, quantization recommendations per model family, cost per 1M tokens baseline vs optimized, and short exec summary for budget approvers.

Workshop notes / items to prepare: 
- LatchKey will provide sample traffic traces (sanitized) and 5 canonical prompt sets.
- Redwood to prepare: baseline hosted API metrics, simulated Dedicated throughput numbers, candidate quant profiles and expected quality delta (BLEU/embedding-sim/hand-eval).
- Action item: Priya to run controlled batch sizing experiment in sandbox and share results before workshop.
